description.value: Corruptive Flaw (the species' non-negotiable cost; scales with Corruption Load). The machine-tongue in his head is not only his. At Corruption Load 0 (Latent band) it is a roleplay tell with no mechanics - rare intrusive impulses, a habit of speaking to devices as if they answer. If he ever chases mutation-power (buying Standard/Signature mutations raises Load) it hardens: at Manifest, fear or corruption pressure forces a Resolve test or he acts rashly a round; at Ascendant, a failed test hands the Director a turn of his actions. He starts clean and stays clean by not feeding the taint.
